先验选择与数据的作用
Choosing Priors and the Role of Data

1 学习目标
1 Learning Goals

Page 1
  1. Learn that the choice of prior affects the posterior.
  2. See that too rigid a prior can make it diﬀicult to learn from the data.
  3. See that more data lessens the dependence of the posterior on the prior.
  4. Be able to make a reasonable choice of prior, based on prior understanding of the system under consideration.

本讲关注先验本身: 不同先验会怎样改变后验, 过于僵化的先验为什么会妨碍学习, 更多数据如何降低结论对先验的依赖.

最终目标是能根据对研究系统的已有认识, 作出并解释一个合理的先验选择, 而不是把先验当作题目永远会直接给出的已知条件.

2 引言
2 Introduction

Page 1

Up to now we have always been handed a prior pdf. In this case, statistical inference from data is essentially an application of Bayes’ theorem. When the prior is known there is no controversy on how to proceed. The art of statistics starts when the prior is not known with certainty. There are two main schools on how to proceed in this case: Bayesian and frequentist. For now we are following the Bayesian approach. Starting next week we will learn the frequentist approach.

之前的题目总是直接给先验密度, 推断只剩下套用贝叶斯定理. 真正困难的是先验并不确定时该怎么办.

对这个问题, **Bayesian 贝叶斯方法**与 **frequentist 频率派方法**采取了不同路线. 本讲仍在贝叶斯框架内讨论如何选择先验, 下一单元再转向频率派.

Page 1

Recall that given data D and a hypothesis H we used Bayes’ theorem to write

P(H∣D)=P(D)P(D∣H)⋅P(H)​,posterior∝likelihood⋅prior.

贝叶斯定理把后验写成「似然 × 先验」再归一化. 数据通过似然进入, 已有认识通过先验进入, 后验同时包含这两部分.

因此, 即使两个人看到完全相同的数据, 只要先验不同, 后验就可能不同. 本讲后面的例子都在观察这种影响何时很大、何时会被数据压下去.

Page 1

Bayesian: Bayesians make inferences using the posterior P(H∣D), and therefore always need a prior P(H). If a prior is not known with certainty the Bayesian must try to make a reasonable choice. There are many ways to do this and reasonable people might make different choices. In general it is good practice to justify your choices and to explore a range of priors to see if they all point to the same conclusion.

贝叶斯推断使用后验 P(H∣D), 所以必须给出先验 P(H). 先验不确定时, 合理的人可能作出不同选择, 这不是计算错误, 而是建模判断不同.

良好做法有两步: 先说明先验依据, 再尝试一组有差异的先验, 看主要结论是否稳定. 如果多种合理先验都指向同一结论, 结论就更有 **robustness 稳健性**.

Page 1

Frequentist: Very briefly, frequentists do not try to create a prior. Instead, they make inferences using the likelihood P(D∣H). We will compare the two approaches in detail once we have more experience with each. For now we simply list two benefits of the Bayesian approach.

  1. The posterior probability P(H∣D) for the hypothesis given the evidence is usually exactly what we’d like to know. The Bayesian can say something like ‘the parameter of interest has probability 0.95 of being between 0.49 and 0.51.’
  2. The assumptions that go into choosing the prior can be clearly spelled out.

频率派不为参数建立先验, 而是直接利用似然作推断. 贝叶斯方法则把参数也放进概率模型, 因此可以说「参数有 95% 的概率落在 0.49 到 0.51 之间」.

这种直接回答参数概率的能力是贝叶斯方法的一项便利. 另一项便利是, 先验所代表的额外假设可以明确写出来, 供别人检查和质疑.

Page 1

More good data: It is always the case that more and better data allows for stronger conclusions and lessens the influence of the prior. The emphasis should be as much on better data (quality) as on more data (quantity).

更多且更好的数据会增强结论, 并降低后验对先验的依赖. 这里不仅要追求样本数量, 也要追求数据质量.

如果抽样有偏、测量不准或实验设计存在系统问题, 单纯增加同类数据并不能自动消除偏差. 「更多数据」不能替代「更好的数据」.

例如只调查某类容易接触的人, 样本再大也可能继续遗漏其他群体. 相比之下, 改进抽样设计、校准测量或减少缺失, 往往比机械扩大样本量更能提高证据质量.

本讲后面比较先验时, 所说「数据压倒先验」也是在既定模型下成立. 模型本身若把关键偏差排除在外, 后验再集中也不等于现实结论可靠.

骰子: 不同先验与僵化先验
Dice: Alternative and Rigid Priors

3 骰子例题
3 Example: Dice

Page 2

Suppose we have a drawer full of dice, each of which has either 4, 6, 8, 12, or 20 sides. This time, we do not know how many of each type are in the drawer. A die is picked at random from the drawer and rolled 5 times. The results in order are 4, 2, 4, 7, and 5.

抽屉里有 4、6、8、12、20 面五种骰子, 但不知道各类数量. 随机取一枚后连掷 5 次, 结果依次是 4、2、4、7、5.

五种「拿到哪种骰子」就是五个假设. 抽屉组成未知意味着先验不再天然均匀, 正适合比较不同先验对后验的影响.

3.1 均匀先验
3.1 Uniform prior

Page 2

Suppose we have no idea what the distribution of dice in the drawer might be. In this case it’s reasonable to use a flat prior. Here is the update table for the posterior probabilities that result from updating after each roll. In order to fit all the columns, we leave out the Bayes numerators.

hyp.priorlik1post1lik2post2lik3post3lik4post4lik5post5
H4​1/51/40.3701/40.5421/40.68200.00000.000
H6​1/51/60.2471/60.2411/60.20200.0001/60.000
H8​1/51/80.1851/80.1351/80.0851/80.8181/80.876
H12​1/51/120.1231/120.0601/120.0251/120.1611/120.115
H20​1/51/200.0741/200.0221/200.0051/200.0211/200.009

This should look familiar. Given the data the final posterior is heavily weighted towards hypthesis H8​ that the 8-sided die was picked.

均匀先验给五种骰子各 1/5. 每次掷骰后, 用该次似然更新上一回后验. 前三次都是较小点数, 面数少的骰子似然更大, 所以 H4​ 一度占优.

第四次掷出 7 后, 4 面和 6 面骰子的似然变为 0, 只剩 8、12、20 面. 其中 8 面骰子对每个可能结果的似然最大, 最后一次掷出 5 后, H8​ 的后验达到 0.876.

读表时, likN 是第 N 次结果在各假设下的似然, postN 则是把前 N 次结果全部纳入后的后验. 每次只对五个未归一化乘积重新归一化, 不必从头重算.

一旦某个假设因不可能结果得到后验 0, 后续乘以有限似然仍为 0. 因此第 5 次的 5 虽在 6 面骰子上本来可能出现, 也不能让 H6​ 恢复概率.

第一次掷出 4 时, 五种骰子都有正似然, 分别为 1/4,1/6,1/8,1/12,1/20. 先验又完全相同, 所以 post1 的相对大小与这五个分数一致: 面数越少, 产生这个点数的概率越大.

3.2 其他先验
3.2 Other priors

Page 2

To see how much the above posterior depended on our choice of prior, let’s try some other priors. Suppose we have reason to believe that there are ten times as many 20-sided dice in the drawer as there are each of the other types. The table becomes:

hyp.priorlik1post1lik2post2lik3post3lik4post4lik5post5
H4​0.0711/40.2221/40.4531/40.65000.00000.000
H6​0.0711/60.1481/60.2021/60.19300.0001/60.000
H8​0.0711/80.1111/80.1131/80.0811/80.6881/80.810
H12​0.0711/120.0741/120.0501/120.0241/120.1361/120.107
H20​0.7141/200.4441/200.1811/200.0521/200.1761/200.083

Even here the final posterior is heavily weighted to the hypothesis H8​.

现在 20 面骰子的先验是其他每一种的 10 倍, 所以 H20​ 起始概率为 0.714. 虽然它在前三次后仍有明显优势, 但后续数据不断削弱它.

最后 H8​ 的后验仍为 0.810, H20​ 只剩 0.083. 说明即使先验明显偏向 20 面, 这组数据仍足以让主要结论转向 8 面.

先验权重可看成 1,1,1,1,10, 归一化后其他四种各约为 0.071, 20 面约为 0.714. 更新时真正与似然相乘的是这些归一化概率, 不是直接把「10 倍」乘到后验上.

Pages 2–3

What if the 20-sided die is 100 times more likely than each of the others?

hyp.priorlik1post1lik2post2lik3post3lik4post4lik5post5
H4​0.00961/40.0441/40.1721/40.44300.00000.000
H6​0.00961/60.0301/60.0771/60.13100.0001/60.000
H8​0.00961/80.0221/80.0431/80.0551/80.2661/80.464
H12​0.00961/120.0151/120.0191/120.0161/120.0531/120.061
H20​0.96151/200.8891/200.6891/200.3541/200.6811/200.475

With such a strong prior belief in the 20-sided die, the final posterior gives a lot of weight to the theory that the data arose from a 20-sided die, even though it extremely unlikely the 20-sided die would produce a maximum of 7 in 5 roles. The posterior now gives roughly even odds that an 8-sided die versus a 20-sided die was picked.

若 20 面骰子的先验是其他每一种的 100 倍, H20​ 的起始概率高达 0.9615. 五次数据不再足以完全压倒这个强先验.

最终 H8​ 为 0.464, H20​ 为 0.475, 两者接近均势. 20 面骰子连续五次都不超过 7 的似然很低, 但极高的先验仍让它保留了约一半后验.

比较 10 倍与 100 倍先验, 可以看到同一组数据并没有变, 变化的是数据需要克服的先验优势. 强先验会让后验移动得更慢, 所以仅凭最终概率不能脱离先验谈「数据本身证明了什么」.

但它仍不同于下面的僵化先验: 这里所有假设的先验都为正, 数据足够强时仍能改变结论.

3.3 僵化先验
3.3 Rigid priors

Page 3

Mild cognitive dissonance. Too rigid a prior belief can overwhelm any amount of data.

Suppose I’ve got it in my head that the die has to be 20-sided. So I set my prior to P(H20​)=1 with the other 4 hypotheses having probability 0. Look what happens in the update table.

hyp.priorlik1post1lik2post2lik3post3lik4post4lik5post5
H4​01/401/401/400000
H6​01/601/601/60001/60
H8​01/801/801/801/801/80
H12​01/1201/1201/1201/1201/120
H20​11/2011/2011/2011/2011/201

No matter what the data, a hypothesis with prior probability 0 will have posterior probability 0. In this case I’ll never get away from the hypothesis H20​, although I might experience some mild cognitive dissonance.

如果先验认定 P(H20​)=1, 其他假设全为 0, 那么无论似然怎样变化, 其他假设的 Bayes 分子始终是「0 × 似然 = 0」.

所以先验为 0 的假设不可能靠数据重新获得后验概率, H20​ 会永远保持为 1. 这不是数据支持它, 而是模型从一开始就不允许其他结论.

Page 3

Severe cognitive dissonance. Rigid priors can also lead to absurdities. Suppose I now have it in my head that the die must be 4-sided. So I set P(H4​)=1 and the other prior probabilities to 0. With the given data on the fourth roll I reach an impasse. A roll of 7 can’t possibly come from a 4-sided die. Yet this is the only hypothesis I’ll allow. My Bayes numerator is a column of all zeros which cannot be normalized.

hyp.priorlik1post1lik2post2lik3post3lik4Bayes numer4post4
H4​11/411/411/4100???
H6​01/601/601/6000???
H8​01/801/801/801/80???
H12​01/1201/1201/1201/120???
H20​01/2001/2001/2001/200???

I must adjust my belief about what is possible or, more likely, I’ll suspect you of accidently or deliberately messing up the data.

若先验只允许 4 面骰子, 前三次结果都与模型相容, 后验始终是 H4​=1. 但第四次出现 7, 唯一允许的假设也得到似然 0.

此时 Bayes 分子整列都是 0, 总概率为 0, 无法归一化, 所以后验栏只能写 ???. 这说明观察结果与整个模型不相容, 必须修改模型或怀疑数据, 不能照常给出后验.

这与只准 H20​ 的情况不同. 后者虽然武断, 数据在模型下仍有正概率, 所以后验可以计算并一直等于 1; 前者则遇到模型赋予零概率的数据, 连条件分布都无法定义.

给不太可能但仍可想象的假设保留很小正先验, 就能避免第二种逻辑僵局, 也让异常数据有机会促使我们修正判断.

原文笔误:扁平先验后的 hypthesis 应为 hypothesis; 100 倍先验处 it extremely unlikely 缺 is, roles 应为 rolls; 僵化先验处 accidently 应为 accidentally.

疟疾: 二维假设与后验
Malaria: Two-Dimensional Hypotheses and Posteriors

4 疟疾例题
4 Example: Malaria

Pages 3–4

Here is a real example adapted from Statistics, A Bayesian Perspective by Donald Berry:

By the 1950s scientists had begun to formulate the hypothesis that carriers of the sickle-cell gene were more resistant to malaria than noncarriers. There was a fair amount of circumstantial evidence for this hypothesis. It also helped explain the persistance of an otherwise deleterious gene in the population. In one experiment scientists injected 30 African volunteers with malaria. Fifteen of the volunteers carried one copy of the sickle-cell gene and the other 15 were noncarriers. Fourteen out of 15 noncarriers developed malaria while only 2 out of 15 carriers did. Does this small sample support the hypothesis that the sickle-cell gene protects against malaria?

Let S represent a carrier of the sickle-cell gene and let N represent a non-carrier. Let D+​ indicate developing malaria and D−​ indicate not developing malaria. The data can be put in a table.

D+​D−​total
S21315
N14115
total161430

实验有 30 名志愿者, 镰状细胞基因携带者 S 与非携带者 N 各 15 人. 携带者中 2 人发病、13 人未发病; 非携带者中 14 人发病、1 人未发病.

问题是这个小样本是否支持「镰状细胞基因对疟疾有保护作用」. 表中总人数为 30, 总发病人数为 16, 不要把这两个数混淆.

Page 4

Before analysing the data we should say a few words about the experiment and experimental design. First, it is clearly unethical: to gain some information they infected 16 people with malaria. We also need to worry about bias. How did they choose the test subjects? Is it possible the noncarriers were weaker and thus more susceptible to malaria than the carriers? Berry points out that it is reasonable to assume that an injection is similar to a mosquito bite, but it is not guaranteed. This last point means that if the experiment shows a relation between sickle-cell and protection against injected malaria, we need to consider the hypothesis that the protection from mosquito transmitted malaria is weaker or non-existent. Finally, we will frame our hypothesis as ’sickle-cell protects against malaria’, but really all we can hope to say from a study like this is that ’sickle-cell is correlated with protection against malaria’.

计算之前必须先审视实验. 主动让人感染疟疾明显不伦理; 受试者如何选择也可能带来偏差, 例如非携带者是否本来就更虚弱.

注射感染也不必然等价于蚊虫传播. 即使实验显示注射情境下的保护作用, 对自然传播情境的对应保护仍可能更弱或不存在.

因此, 这种研究最多直接支持「镰状细胞基因与保护作用相关」, 不能仅凭后验概率很高就推出普遍的因果关系.

原文笔误:实验总人数为 30, 原文却写 they infected 16 people with malaria, 应为 30. 另外 persistance 应为 persistence.

Page 4

Model. For our model let θS​ be the probability that an injected carrier S develops malaria and likewise let θN​ be the probability that an injected noncarrier N develops malaria. We assume independence between all the experimental subjects. With this model, the likelihood is a function of both θS​ and θN​:

P(data∣θS​,θN​)=cθS2​(1−θS​)13θN14​(1−θN​).

As usual we leave the constant factor c as a letter. (It is a product of two binomial coefficients: c=(215​)(1415​).)

模型有两个未知参数: θS​ 是携带者注射后的发病概率, θN​ 是非携带者注射后的发病概率. 假设所有受试者相互独立, 两组的似然就可以相乘.

携带者组贡献 θS2​(1−θS​)13, 非携带者组贡献 θN14​(1−θN​). 常数 c 是两个二项系数的乘积, 不含参数, 归一化时不需要展开.

这里不能只设一个共同发病概率, 否则就无法表达两组风险不同. 两个参数让数据可以分别支持「携带者风险低」和「非携带者风险高」, 二者的对比正是保护作用问题.

独立性只用于说明为什么个体结果的概率可以相乘, 并不自动保证两组分配没有偏差, 也不等于已经证明基因导致风险变化.

Pages 4–5

Hypotheses. Each hypothesis consists of a pair (θN​,θS​). To keep things simple we will only consider a finite number of values for these probabilities. We could easily consider many more values or even a continuous range of hypotheses. Assume θS​ and θN​ are each one of 0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, 1. This leads to two-dimensional tables.

First is a table of hypotheses. The color coding indicates the following:

  1. Light blue squares along the diagonal are where θS​=θN​, i.e. sickle-cell makes no difference one way or the other.
  2. Orange and darker blue squares above the diagonal are where θN​>θS​, i.e. sickle-cell provides some protection against malaria.
  3. In the orange squares θN​−θS​≥0.6, i.e. sickle-cell provides a lot of protection.
  4. White squares below diagonal are where θS​>θN​, i.e. sickle-cell actually increases the probability of developing malaria.
θN​\θS​00.20.40.60.81
1(0,1)(.2,1)(.4,1)(.6,1)(.8,1)(1,1)
0.8(0,.8)(.2,.8)(.4,.8)(.6,.8)(.8,.8)(1,.8)
0.6(0,.6)(.2,.6)(.4,.6)(.6,.6)(.8,.6)(1,.6)
0.4(0,.4)(.2,.4)(.4,.4)(.6,.4)(.8,.4)(1,.4)
0.2(0,.2)(.2,.2)(.4,.2)(.6,.2)(.8,.2)(1,.2)
0(0,0)(.2,0)(.4,0)(.6,0)(.8,0)(1,0)

Hypotheses on level of protection due to S: orange = strong; darker blue = some; light blue = none; white = negative.

每个假设都是一个参数对 (θN​,θS​). 两个参数各取 6 个值, 形成 36 个格子, 每个格子对应一种组合.

对角线 θS​=θN​ 表示没有差别; 对角线上方 θN​>θS​ 表示携带者发病概率更低, 即有保护; 差值至少 0.6 记为强保护; 对角线下方案则表示携带者反而更容易发病.

表头 θN​\θS​ 提醒行是非携带者风险, 列是携带者风险. 例如 θN​=0.8,θS​=0.2 位于对角线上方, 差值为 0.6, 属于强保护格.

后面计算某类假设的概率时, 就是把这类格子的概率全部加起来. 分类看的是参数关系, 不是格子离表格左上或右下的视觉距离.

似然与平坦先验
Likelihoods and a flat prior

Page 5

Next is the table of likelihoods. (Actually we’ve taken advantage of our indifference to scale and scaled all the likelihoods by 100000/c to make the table more presentable.) Notice that, to the precision of the table, many of the likelihoods are 0. The color coding is the same as in the hypothesis table. We’ve highlighted the biggest likelihoods with a thick black border.

Likelihoods p(data∣θS​,θN​) scaled by 100000/c

似然表对每一格计算同一组数据在该参数组合下的概率. 全表统一乘以 100000/c, 只是为了让数字易读, 不改变各格的相对大小, 也不影响后验.

最大的似然在 θN​=0.8,θS​=0.2, 次大的在 θN​=0.8,θS​=0.4. 许多格显示为 0 是保留五位小数后的结果, 不一定都是数学上的精确零.

有些端点格确实必须为 0. 例如 θS​=0 表示携带者不可能发病, 与实际观察到 2 人发病矛盾; θS​=1 则表示携带者必然全部发病, 又与 13 人未发病矛盾.

其他非端点格通常只是相对似然太小, 四舍五入后显示为 0. 归一化时这些小量仍按原计算值参与, 不应把显示值当作截断模型的依据.

4.1 平坦先验
4.1 Flat prior

Page 5

Suppose we have no opinion whatsoever on whether and to what degree sickle-cell protects against malaria. In this case it is reasonable to use a flat prior. Since there are 36 hypotheses each one gets a prior probability of 1/36. This is given in the table below. Remember each square in the table represents one hypothesis. Because it is a probability table we include the marginal pmfs.

θN​\θS​00.20.40.60.81p(θN​)
11/361/361/361/361/361/361/6
0.81/361/361/361/361/361/361/6
0.61/361/361/361/361/361/361/6
0.41/361/361/361/361/361/361/6
0.21/361/361/361/361/361/361/6
01/361/361/361/361/361/361/6
p(θS​)1/61/61/61/61/61/61

Flat prior p(θS​,θN​): every hypothesis (square) has equal probability

平坦先验给 36 个参数组合各 1/36. 每行有 6 格, 所以 θN​ 的每个边缘概率为 1/6; 每列同理, θS​ 的每个边缘概率也是 1/6.

边缘概率就是把另一参数的所有取值加总. 全表总和为 1, 这是后续逐格相乘和归一化的起点.

平坦先验的后验
Posterior to the flat prior

Page 6

To compute the posterior we simply multiply the likelihood table by the prior table and normalize. Normalization means making sure the entire table sums to 1.

θN​\θS​00.20.40.60.81p(θN​∣data)
10.000000.000000.000000.000000.000000.000000.00000
0.80.000000.880750.083700.000970.000000.000000.96542
0.60.000000.031390.002980.000030.000000.000000.03440
0.40.000000.000160.000020.000000.000000.000000.00018
0.20.000000.000000.000000.000000.000000.000000.00000
00.000000.000000.000000.000000.000000.000000.00000
p(θS​∣data)0.000000.912300.086700.001000.000000.000001.00000

Posterior to flat prior: p(θS​,θN​∣data)

平坦先验下, 每格先验相同, 所以后验形状基本由似然决定. 逐格相乘后, 再除以全表总和, 使 36 格后验之和为 1.

最大后验格是 (θN​,θS​)=(0.8,0.2), 概率 0.88075. 行和与列和给出两个参数各自的后验边缘分布.

似然表里的 1.93428 不是概率, 所以不会直接出现在后验表中. 它先与其他格一起决定相对权重, 再经过全表归一化, 才变成 0.88075.

边缘后验回答的是单个参数的问题. 例如最下面一行把每列六格相加, 表示只关心 θS​ 时各取值的概率; 它已经不再区分对应的 θN​.

Page 6

To decide whether S confers protection against malaria, we compute the posterior probabilities of ‘some protection’ and of ‘strong protection’. These are computed by summing the corresponding squares in the posterior table.

Some protection: P(θN​>θS​)=sum of orange and darker blue=0.99995

Strong protection: P(θN​−θS​>0.6)=sum of orange=0.88075

Working from the flat prior, it is effectively certain that sickle-cell provides some protection and very probable that it provides strong protection.

要回答「是否有保护」, 不能只读最大的一格, 而要把满足 θN​>θS​ 的所有格子相加, 得到 0.99995.

强保护对应差值足够大的格子, 表中合计为 0.88075. 定义部分用「至少 0.6」, 这里公式写「大于 0.6」; 在当前网格上, 非零后验主要集中在差值恰为 0.6 的那一格, 所以数值结论指向同一格.

4.2 有信息先验
4.2 Informed prior

Page 6

The experiment was not run without prior information. There was a lot of circumstantial evidence that the sickle-cell gene offered some protection against malaria. For example it was reported that a greater percentage of carriers survived to adulthood.

Here’s one way to build an informed prior. We’ll reserve a reasonable amount of probability for the hypotheses that S gives no protection. Let’s say 24% split evenly among the 6 (light blue) cells where θN​=θS​. We know we shouldn’t set any prior probabilities to 0, so let’s spread 6% of the probability evenly among the 15 white cells below the diagonal. That leaves 70% of the probability for the 15 orange and darker blue squares above the diagonal.

θN​\θS​00.20.40.60.81p(θN​)
10.046670.046670.046670.046670.046670.040000.27333
0.80.046670.046670.046670.046670.040000.004000.23067
0.60.046670.046670.046670.040000.004000.004000.18800
0.40.046670.046670.040000.004000.004000.004000.14533
0.20.046670.040000.004000.004000.004000.004000.10267
00.040000.004000.004000.004000.004000.004000.06000
p(θS​)0.273330.230670.188000.145330.102670.060001.0

Informed prior p(θS​,θN​): makes use of prior information that sickle-cell is protective.

实验前已有间接证据支持保护作用, 因此可以构造 **informed prior 有信息先验**. 这里给无保护的对角线 24%, 给反方向的 15 格共 6%, 给有保护的 15 格共 70%.

各区域内部再平均分配: 对角线每格 0.04, 反方向每格 0.004, 有保护区域每格约 0.04667. 没有任何格子被设为先验 0, 因此数据仍有机会改变结论.

三部分总质量 24%、6%、70% 合计为 100%, 所以整张表本身就是一个归一化的联合 pmf. 右侧与下侧的边缘概率则把这些格子按行、列重新汇总.

这个先验体现了「保护较可能, 但无保护和反作用仍有可能」. 它不是把已有间接证据当作确定事实, 而是把证据转换成可更新的概率分配.

Page 7

We then compute the posterior pmf.

θN​\θS​00.20.40.60.81p(θN​∣data)
10.000000.000000.000000.000000.000000.000000.00000
0.80.000000.880760.083700.000970.000000.000000.96543
0.60.000000.031390.002980.000030.000000.000000.03440

0.20.000000.000000.000000.000000.000000.000000.00000

Posterior to informed prior: p(θS​,θN​∣data)

We again compute the posterior probabilities of ‘some protection’ and of ‘strong protection’.

Some protection: P(θN​>θS​)=sum of orange and darker blue=0.99996

Strong protection: P(θN​−θS​>0.6)=sum of orange=0.88076

Note that the informed posterior is nearly identical to the flat posterior.

有信息先验下, 有保护和强保护的后验概率分别为 0.99996 与 0.88076, 和平坦先验的 0.99995、0.88075 几乎相同.

原因是主要非零格都落在同一个有保护区域, 在该区域内的先验又相同; 数据的似然峰很集中, 先验之间的差别在归一化后几乎看不见.

换句话说, 两种先验虽然在整个 36 格上分配不同, 但在数据真正看重的少数格子上, 相对权重几乎一样. 其他格子即使先验差异较大, 似然太小也难以影响最终答案.

所以这里的稳健性是针对这组数据、这片高似然区域和这两种合理先验而言, 不是断言换成任何先验都不会改变结论.

4.3 差值至少为 x 的概率 (PDALX)
4.3 PDALX

Page 7

The following plot is based on the flat prior. For each x, it gives the probability that θN​−θS​≥x. To make it smooth we used many more hypotheses.

Probability the difference θN​−θS​ is at least x (PDALX).

Notice that it is almost certain that the difference is at least 0.4.

**PDALX** 表示「差值至少为 x 的概率」. 横轴给出阈值 x, 纵轴是 P(θN​−θS​≥x∣data), 所以这是一条随阈值增大而下降的尾部概率曲线.

曲线在 x=0.4 附近仍接近 1, 表示在模型和先验下, 两组发病概率之差至少为 0.4 几乎确定. 为画得更平滑, 原图采用了比 6×6 更密的假设网格.

读这条曲线要固定一个横轴阈值, 再向上读累计概率, 而不是把它当作差值的 pdf. 曲线高度不表示「差值恰好等于 x」的密度, 而表示「差值达到或超过 x」的总概率.

阈值越大, 满足条件的参数区域越小, 所以曲线整体向右下降. 它能一次展示多个强保护标准下的结论.

ECMO 与 CVT: 先验稳健性
ECMO and CVT: Robustness to Priors

严重呼吸衰竭的治疗
Board question preamble: Treating severe respiratory failure*

Slides 10–11

Two treatments for newborns with severe respiratory failure.

  1. CVT: conventional therapy (hyperventilation and drugs)
  2. ECMO: extracorporeal membrane oxygenation (invasive procedure)

In 1983 in Michigan:

19/19 ECMO babies survived and 0/3 CVT babies survived.

Later Harvard ran a randomized study:

28/29 ECMO babies survived and 6/10 CVT babies survived.

*Adapted from Statistics: a Bayesian Perspective by Donald Berry

题目比较 ECMO 与常规治疗 CVT. Michigan 数据用于形成分析 Harvard 数据前的先验, Harvard 的随机研究数据用于当前更新.

两个参数先验的更新
Board question: Updating two parameter priors

Slides 10–11

Michigan: 19/19 ECMO babies and 0/3 CVT babies survived.

Harvard: 28/29 ECMO babies and 6/10 CVT babies survived.

θE​ = probability that an ECMO baby survives

θC​ = probability that a CVT baby survives

Consider the values 0.125, 0.375, 0.625, 0.875 for θE​ and θC​.

(a) Make the 4×4 prior table for a flat prior.

(b) Based on the Michigan results, create a reasonable informed prior table for analyzing the Harvard results (unnormalized is fine).

(c) Make the likelihood table for the Harvard results. (You might use R to compute some of the values.)

(d) Find the posterior table for the informed prior.

(e) Using the informed posterior, compute the probability that ECMO is better than CVT.

(f) Also compute the posterior probability that θE​−θC​≥0.6.

(The posted solutions will also show 4-6 for the flat prior.)

题目比较 ECMO 与常规治疗 CVT. Michigan 数据用于形成分析 Harvard 数据前的先验, Harvard 的随机研究数据用于当前更新.

两个存活率参数 θE​,θC​ 各取 0.125、0.375、0.625、0.875, 所以仍有 16 个二维假设. 要分别构造平坦和有信息先验, 再比较后验结论是否对先验选择敏感.

分析顺序要分清: Michigan 结果出现在先验构造阶段, Harvard 结果出现在似然阶段. 题目不是把两项研究的人数直接合并成一个大样本, 而是研究「过去证据形成先验, 新随机研究再更新」的流程.

最后两问把二维后验翻译成容易解释的事件: ECMO 存活率是否更高, 以及优势是否至少达到 0.6. 两者都要按参数格子求和, 而不是只比较两组样本比例.

官方平坦先验
Solution: (a) Flat prior

4×4 共 16 个假设, 平坦先验每格给 1/16=0.0625. 这表示在更新前不对任何参数组合作额外倾斜.

官方有信息先验与似然
Official informed prior and likelihood

Rationale: Since 19/19 ECMO babies survived we believe θE​ is probably near 1.0. That 0/3 CVT babies survived is not enough data to move from a uniform distribution. (Or we might distribute a little more probability to larger θC​.) So for θE​ we split 64% of probability in the two higher values and 36% for the lower two. Our prior is the same for each value of θC​.

官方有信息先验给 θE​ 较低两档各 18, 较高两档各 32. 归一化后, 高档合计 64%, 低档合计 36%, 反映 Michigan 的 19/19 存活让 ECMO 存活率更可能接近 1.

CVT 只有 0/3 的少量数据, 官方选择不据此强烈改变 θC​ 的均匀分布, 所以四行权重相同. 这个先验是合理选择之一, 不是唯一正确答案.

18 和 32 是未归一化权重, 不是概率百分数. 真正更新前可以把整张表同除以总和; 即使省略这一步, 最后的后验归一化也会消去共同尺度.

这里也没有直接使用 Michigan 的二项似然作为先验, 而是把旧信息概括成较温和的离散权重. 这种做法保留主观判断空间, 也避免把极小的旧样本当作非常精确的知识.

All our computations were done in R. For the flat posterior:

P(θE​>θC​∣Harvard data)=0.936,P(θE​−θC​≥0.6∣Harvard data)=0.001.

平坦先验各格相同, 因此后验与似然表成比例. 后验主要集中在 θE​=0.875 这一列, 尤其在 θC​=0.375 与 0.625 两行.

把 θE​>θC​ 的格子相加, 得到 ECMO 更好的概率约 0.936; 把差值至少 0.6 的格子相加, 概率约 0.001. 「平坦后验」只表示它来自平坦先验, 后验本身显然不再平坦.

第一问采用严格大于, 所以对角线上两种疗法存活率相等的格子不计入. 第二问采用大于或等于, 差值恰好为 0.6 的格子必须包括在内.

这两个答案也互补地说明: 「ECMO 很可能更好」不等于「ECMO 很可能好很多」. 后验可以高度支持方向为正, 却只给很大的优势分配很小概率.

已核对的精确值约为 0.935938509 与 0.001303653, 与官方保留位数一致. 主要结论不随这组先验选择改变, 因此具有稳健性.

不过, 若把 Michigan 的完整后验直接作为 Harvard 的先验, 那是另一种顺序更新模型, 会得到不同数值, 不能与官方这组构造混为一谈.

连续二维参数分布
Continuous two-parameter distributions

Slide 9

(This is preparation for the board problem.)

Sometimes continuous parameters are more natural.

Malaria example (from class notes):

discrete prior table from the class notes.

Similarly colored version for the continuous parameters (θS​,θN​) over range [0,1]×[0,1].

The probabilities are given by double integrals over regions.

离散网格只是对连续参数的近似. 若 θS​,θN​ 都在 [0,1] 连续变化, 假设空间就是单位正方形, 有保护、强保护等条件对应其中的区域.

这时不能再数格子求和, 而要把联合后验密度在相应区域上做二重积分. 颜色仍用于区分参数之间的大小关系.

例如有保护对应 θN​>θS​ 的区域, 强保护则还要满足 θN​−θS​≥0.6. 积分区域由这些不等式决定, 被积函数才是后验密度.

离散表中的「逐格概率」到了连续情形变成「小块面积上的概率」. 单个精确参数对的概率为 0, 只有对一片区域积分才得到正概率.

概率区间与分位数
Probability Intervals and Quantiles

1 概率区间的学习目标
1 Learning Goals

Page 1
  1. Be able to find probability intervals given a pmf or pdf.
  2. Understand how probability intervals summarize belief in Bayesian updating.
  3. Be able to use subjective probability intervals to construct reasonable priors.
  4. Be able to construct subjective probability intervals by systematically estimating quantiles.

第二份讲义转向概率区间. 目标是能从 pmf 或 pdf 找出具有指定概率的区间, 用区间概括贝叶斯信念, 并反过来用主观区间和分位数构造先验.

前半部分是从分布得到区间, 后半部分是从想要的区间反推分布.

2 概率区间
2 Probability intervals

Page 1

Suppose we have a pmf p(θ) or pdf f(θ) describing our belief about the value of an unknown parameter of interest θ.

Definition: A p-probability interval for θ is an interval [a,b] with P(a≤θ≤b)=p.

Notes.

  1. In the discrete case with pmf p(θ), this means ∑a≤θi​≤b​p(θi​)=p.
  2. In the continuous case with pdf f(θ), this means ∫ab​f(θ)dθ=p.
  3. We may say 90%-probability interval to mean 0.9-probability interval. Probability intervals are also called credible intervals to contrast them with confidence intervals, which we will introduce in the frequentist unit.

**probability interval 概率区间** [a,b] 只要求参数落在其中的总概率等于 p. 离散情形把区间内各点的 pmf 相加, 连续情形对 pdf 在 [a,b] 上积分.

90% 概率区间就是 p=0.9. 贝叶斯语境中也叫 **credible interval 可信区间**, 用来区别后面频率派的 confidence interval.

例如一个 90% 对称概率区间会写成 [q0.05​,q0.95​], 左右各留下 5% 的尾概率. 这里的 90% 是区间内的总概率, 不是每个端点各自有 90% 概率.

离散情形要注意端点是否包含, 因为单点 pmf 可能为正; 连续情形改变单个端点不影响积分值.

Page 1

Example 1. Between the 0.05 and 0.55 quantiles is a 0.5 probability interval. There are many 50% probability intervals, e.g. the interval from the 0.25 to the 0.75 quantiles.

In particular, notice that the p-probability interval for θ is not unique.

Q-notation. We can phrase probability intervals in terms of quantiles. Recall that the s-quantile for θ is the value qs​ with P(θ≤qs​)=s. So for s≤t, the amount of probability between the s-quantile and the t-quantile is just t−s. In these terms, a p-probability interval is any interval [qs​,qt​] with t−s=p.

Example 2. We have 0.5 probability intervals [q0.25​,q0.75​] and [q0.05​,q0.55​].

**quantile 分位数** qs​ 满足 P(θ≤qs​)=s. 两个分位数之间的概率就是下标之差, 所以 [qs​,qt​] 包含 t−s 的概率.

同一个概率可以有很多区间. 例如 [q0.05​,q0.55​] 和 [q0.25​,q0.75​] 都是 50% 区间, 因为它们的分位数下标都相差 0.5.

可以把 qs​ 看成 CDF 达到高度 s 时的横坐标. q0.25​ 与 q0.75​ 分别把最低和最高各四分之一的质量分在外侧, 中间自然留下一半.

移动整对分位数而保持下标差不变, 只改变区间的位置, 不改变它覆盖的概率. 这就是不唯一性的来源.

Pages 1–2

Symmetric probability intervals.

The interval [q0.25​,q0.75​] is symmetric because the amount of probability remaining on either side of the interval is the same, namely 0.25. If the pdf is not too skewed, the symmetric interval is usually a good default choice.

More notes.

  1. Different p-probability intervals for θ may have different widths. We can make the width smaller by centering the interval under the highest part of the pdf. Such an interval is usually a good choice since it contains the most likely values. See the examples below for normal and beta distributions.
  2. Since the width can vary for fixed p, a larger p does not always mean a larger width. Here’s what is true: if a p1​-probability interval is fully contained in a p2​-probability interval, then p1​ is smaller than p2​.

**symmetric probability interval 对称概率区间**指左右两侧留下相同尾概率. [q0.25​,q0.75​] 左右各留 0.25, 是常用的 50% 默认区间; 分布不太偏斜时尤其自然.

但等尾不一定最短. 把区间放在密度最高的区域, 通常能用更短长度覆盖相同概率. 也不能脱离具体区间说「概率越大, 长度一定越大」; 只有当一个区间完全包含另一个时, 才能直接比较概率大小.

例如一条位置偏远的短区间可能只覆盖较低的密度, 而另一条居中的区间即使更短, 也可能覆盖更多概率. 因此概率由曲线下面积决定, 不是由横轴长度单独决定.

若一个区间完全包含另一个, 被包含区间的所有概率质量也都属于外层区间, 所以外层概率不可能更小. 这个包含关系才是原文最后一条比较规则的关键.

正态分布的概率区间
Probability intervals for a normal distribution

Page 2

The figure shows a number of probability intervals for the standard normal.

  1. All of the blue bars span a 0.68-probability interval. Notice that the smallest blue bar runs between -1 and 1. This runs from the 16th percentile to the 84th percentile so it is a symmetric interval.
  2. All the green bars span a 0.9-probability interval. They are longer than the blue bars because they include more probability. Note again that the shortest green bar is symmetric.

orange = 0.5, blue = 0.68, green = 0.9

图中同颜色的横线可以放在不同位置, 但覆盖的概率相同. 标准正态的 68% 最短区间是 [−1,1], 大约从第 16 百分位到第 84 百分位, 左右尾概率相等.

90% 区间要覆盖更多概率, 图中的绿线相应更长, 最短的绿线同样采用对称位置. 对标准正态这种对称单峰密度, 居中区间也是最短的.

直观地看, 中心附近的密度最高. 若把一段区间向旁边移动, 就会失去一段高密度区域, 换进一段低密度尾部; 想保持原概率, 只能把区间拉得更长.

这里「68% 区间是 [−1,1]」说的是标准正态. 换成一般正态或其他分布, 端点必须重新按相应分位数确定, 不能照搬 ±1.

Beta 分布的概率区间
Probabilitiy intervals for a beta distribution

Page 2

The following figure shows probability intervals for a beta distribution. Notice how the two blue bars have very different lengths yet cover the same probability p=0.68.

orange = 0.5, blue = 0.68, green = 0.9

Beta(10,4) 的密度偏斜, 两条蓝色区间虽然都覆盖 68% 概率, 长度却可以差很多. 放在高密度区域的区间更短, 放在尾部的区间更长.

所以「对称分位区间」与「最短区间」是两个不同标准. 前者强调两侧尾概率相等, 后者强调用最少长度包含指定概率.

读图时可以用面积直觉检查: 一条区间虽然较短, 但若位于密度高处, 覆盖面积仍可能很大; 另一条伸向尾部的长区间, 可能只收集到很薄的密度.

这也是为什么报告概率区间时必须给出端点和概率, 不能只给区间长度. 长度本身不能唯一说明其中有多少信念质量.

原文笔误:Beta 分布段标题写 Probabilitiy intervals, 应为 Probability intervals. Step 2 的 approximats 应为 approximates. 后文 than than 重复, 应删去一个 than.

3 概率区间的用途
3 Uses of probability intervals

3.1 概括并沟通信念
3.1 Summarizing and communicating your beliefs

Page 3

Probability intervals are an intuitive and effective way to summarize and communicate your beliefs. It’s hard to describe an entire function f(θ) to a friend in words. If the function isn’t from a parameterized family then it’s especially hard. Even with a beta distribution, it’s easier to interpret “I think θ is between 0.45 and 0.65 with 50% probability” than “I think θ follows a beta(8,6) distribution”. An exception to this rule of communication might be the normal distribution, but only if the recipient is also comfortable with standard deviation.

Of course, what we gain in clarity we lose in precision, since the function contains more information than the probability interval.

完整密度函数包含全部信息, 但不容易口头沟通. 「我认为 θ 有 50% 的概率在 0.45 到 0.65 之间」通常比报出 Beta 参数更直观.

代价是信息损失: 一个区间不能告诉我们分布的峰值、尾部和其他形状. 概率区间是摘要, 不是完整后验的替代品.

Page 3

Probability intervals also play well with Bayesian updating. If we update from the prior f(θ) to the posterior f(θ∣x), then the p-probability interval for the posterior will tend to be shorter than than the p-probability interval for the prior. In this sense, the data has made us more certain. See for example the election example below.

数据使后验通常比先验更集中, 所以相同概率水平的后验区间往往会变短. 这种缩短可以直观表示不确定性下降.

原文说的是 tend to, 即一般趋势, 不是任何区间、任何数据下都必然缩短. 还要看具体后验形状和采用哪一种区间.

4 用主观概率区间构造先验
4 Constructing a prior using subjective probability intervals

Page 3

Probability intervals are also useful when we do not have a pmf or pdf at hand. In this case, subjective probability intervals give us a method for constructing a reasonable prior for θ “from scratch”. The thought process is to ask yourself a series of questions, e.g., ‘what is my expected value for θ?’; ‘my 0.5-probability interval?’; ‘my 0.9-probability interval?’. Then build a prior that is consistent with these intervals.

没有现成分布时, 可以先问自己: 参数的中心大概在哪里? 我认为合理的 50% 和 90% 区间是什么? 再选一个与这些回答相容的分布作为先验.

这把难以直接指定的密度参数, 转换成更容易解释的概率判断. 它仍然是主观建模, 但假设更透明, 也便于别人讨论.

4.1 直接估计区间
4.1 Estimating the intervals directly

Page 4

Example 3. Building priors

In 2013 there was a special election for a congressional seat in a district in South Carolina. The election pitted Republican Mark Sanford against Democrat Elizabeth Colbert Busch. Let θ be the fraction of the population who favored Sanford. Our goal in this example is to build a subjective prior for θ. We’ll use the following prior evidence.

  • Sanford is a former S. Carolina Congressman and Governor
  • In 2009, while Governor, he had to resign after he was discovered to be having an affair in Argentina while he claimed to be hiking the Appalachian trail.
  • In 2013 Sanford won the Republican primary over 15 primary opponents.
  • In the district in the 2012 presidential election the Republican Romney beat the Democrat Obama 58% to 40%.
  • The Colbert bump: Elizabeth Colbert Busch is the sister of well-known comedian Stephen Colbert.

Our strategy will be to use our intuition to construct some probability intervals and then find a beta distribution that approximately matches these intervals. This is subjective so someone else might give a different answer.

例 3 要为 Sanford 的支持率 θ 构造主观先验. 可用证据包括他的从政经历、负面事件、党内初选胜利、该选区过去的共和党得票, 以及对手的知名度.

策略不是直接猜 Beta 参数, 而是先根据这些证据给出概率区间, 再找一条大致匹配的 Beta 曲线. 证据权重由人判断, 所以不同人得到不同先验很正常.

Page 4

Step 1. Use the evidence to construct 0.5 and 0.9 probability intervals for θ.

We’ll start by thinking about the 90% interval. The single strongest prior evidence is the 58% to 40% of Romney over Obama. Given the negatives for Sanford we don’t expect he’ll win much more than 58% of the vote. So we’ll put the top of the 0.9 interval at 0.65. With all of Sanford’s negatives he could lose big. So we’ll put the bottom at 0.3.

0.9 interval: [0.3,0.65]

For the 0.5 interval we’ll pull these endpoints in. It really seems unlikely Sanford will get more votes than Romney, so we can leave 0.25 probability that he’ll get above 57%. The lower limit seems harder to predict. So we’ll leave 0.25 probability that he’ll get under 42%.

0.5 interval: [0.42,0.57]

第一步先给较宽的 90% 区间 [0.3,0.65]. 上限参考该选区过去的共和党表现并留出一定空间, 下限则反映候选人负面因素可能造成的惨败.

50% 区间缩为 [0.42,0.57], 左右各留下约 25% 的尾概率. 这些端点不是数据算出的精确答案, 而是对现有证据的主观概括.

Page 4

Step 2. Use our 0.5 and 0.9 probability intervals to pick a beta distribution that approximats these intervals. We used the R function pbeta and a little trial and error to choose beta(11,12). Here is our R code.

a = 11
b = 12
pbeta(0.65, a, b) - pbeta(0.3, a, b)
pbeta(0.57, a, b) - pbeta(0.42, a, b)

This computed P([0.3,0.65])=0.91 and P([0.42,0.57])=0.52. So our intervals are actually 0.91 and 0.52-probability intervals. This is pretty close to what we wanted!

第二步用 `pbeta` 计算候选 Beta 分布在两个区间内的概率, 通过试错选择 Beta(11,12). 得到的两段概率约为 0.913874 与 0.519782, 与目标 0.9 和 0.5 接近.

代码中的减法就是 CDF 的区间概率: P(a≤θ≤b)=F(b)−F(a). 拟合只需足够接近, 并不要求精确命中主观端点.

Beta(11,12) 的中心略低于 0.5, 反映例子对 Sanford 的谨慎判断. 两条区间又分别约束中心区域与更宽尾部, 合起来比只报一个均值更能确定先验形状.

满足这些近似区间的分布并不唯一. 选择 Beta 是因为支持率位于 [0,1], 且这个分布族便于调整和更新, 不是因为它是唯一可接受的答案.

Page 4

The plot below shows the density of beta(11,12). The horizontal orange line shows our interval [0.42, 0.57] and the blue line shows our interval [0.3, 0.65].

beta(11,12) fitting 0.5 and 0.9 probability intervals

图中的短橙线对应 [0.42,0.57], 长蓝线对应 [0.3,0.65]. 较宽的区间包含更多密度, 所以应分别对应约 0.52 和 0.91 的概率.

图内文字把这两个概率标签对调了. 判断时既要看正文计算, 也要看区间宽度与曲线下面积是否一致.

幻灯片前后不一致:图内把 [0.42,0.57] 标成 0.91 interval, 把 [0.3,0.65] 标成 0.52 interval, 与正文和实际积分相反. 正确是 [0.42,0.57] 约 0.52, [0.3,0.65] 约 0.91.

4.2 通过分位数构造先验
4.2 Constructing a prior by estimating quantiles

Pages 4–5

The method in Example 3 gives a good feel for building priors from probability intervals. Here we illustrate a slightly different way of building a prior by estimating quantiles.

The basic strategy is to first estimate the median, then divide and conquer to estimate the first and third quantiles. Finally you choose a prior distribution that fits these estimates.

Example 4. Redo the Sanford vs. Colbert-Busch election example using quantiles.

Solution: We start by estimating the median. Just as before the single strongest evidence is the 58% to 40% victory of Romney over Obama. However, given Sanford’s negatives and Busch’s Colbert bump we’ll estimate the median at 0.47.

另一种方法是直接估计分位数. 先给中位数, 再把两侧各分成两半, 估计第一和第三四分位数, 最后选择能拟合这些点的分布.

在同一选举例中, 中位数先估为 0.47. 它参考了共和党过去的优势, 同时考虑 Sanford 的负面因素与对手的知名度.

「分而治之」是指中位数先把分布分成上下两半, 再分别找出两半的中点, 得到 25% 和 75% 分位数. 与一次性想象完整密度相比, 这种逐步定位更容易给出可解释的判断.

三个点确定后, 还要检查它们是否严格递增、是否落在参数允许范围内, 再开始拟合分布.

Page 5

In a district that went 58 to 40 for the Republican Romney it’s hard to imagine Sanford’s vote going a lot below 40%. So we’ll estimate Sanford 25th percentile as 0.40. Likewise, given his negatives it’s hard to imagine him going above 58%, so we’ll estimate his 75th percentile as 0.55.

We used R to search through values of a and b for the beta distribution that matches these quartiles the best. Since the beta distribution does not require a and b to be integers we looked for the best fit to 1 decimal place. We found beta(9.9, 11.0). Above is a plot of beta(9.9,11.0) with its actual quartiles shown. These match the desired quartiles pretty well.

beta(9.9, 11.0) matching desired quartiles

目标的三个四分位数是 0.40、0.47、0.55. 用 R 搜索到 Beta(9.9,11.0), 实际约为 0.399、0.472、0.547, 已经很接近.

Beta 参数不必是整数, 所以可以按一位小数细调. 这里拟合的是三个分位点, 与上一例拟合两个区间概率是同一思路的不同操作方式.

Page 5

Historic note. In the election Sanford won 54% of the vote and Busch won 45.2%. (Source: https://elections.huffingtonpost.com/2013/mark-sanford-vs-elizabeth-colbert-busch-sc1)

实际选举中 Sanford 得票 54%, Busch 得票 45.2%. 这个结果落在前面构造的中心区域内, 说明先验没有明显偏离现实.

但事后结果接近先验中心, 并不能证明主观构造方法必然正确; 它只是这项先验的一次事后对照.

流星: 热图、方向与区间
Meteor: Heat Maps, Direction, and Intervals

流星!
Meteor!

流星方向: 没有数据
Board question: Meteor! (a) No data.

Slides 24–25

On March 22, 2013, a meteor lit up the skies. It passed almost directly over NYC.

(Public domain image courtesy of NASA.)

Draw a pdf f(θ),0≤θ<2π, for the meteor’s direction.

Draw a 0.5-probability interval. How long is it?

Let θ=0 mean due east.

(Stay at the board for the next questions.)

没有方向数据时, 最自然的先验是在 [0,2π) 上均匀分布, 即 f(θ)=1/(2π). 这表示没有任何方向被预先偏爱.

50% 概率区间需要覆盖半圈, 长度为 π. 可以取 [0,π], 也可以绕圆平移到任意起点, 因为概率区间并不唯一.

均匀密度为 1/(2π), 所以长度 π 的区间概率就是密度乘长度, 即 1/2. 方向角绕圆一周相同, 跨过 0 的区间也可以按圆周理解, 不必强行局限在一次线性坐标里.

后续若后验不再均匀, 同样长度的不同方向区间就不再具有相同概率, 需要根据更新后的密度形状选择.

流星方向: 目击热图
Board question: Meteor! (b) Heat map.

Slide 26

Heat map of the number of reported sightings

Image created from data taken from https://amsmeteors.org/2013/03/update-for-march-22-2013-northeast-fireball

Based on this, update your pdf for the meteor’s direction, i.e. draw a new graph. Call the new pdf f(θ∣x1​).

Estimate a 0.5-probability interval. How long is it?

热图显示目击报告集中在纽约及附近城市. 若只把它作为方向证据, 后验会比均匀先验更集中, 50% 区间也会小于 π.

但报告数量还受人口、媒体覆盖和目击者分布影响, 最热处不能直接等同于真实方向. 题目没有数值化似然, 所以只能讨论后验形状和区间缩短, 不能编造精确端点.

流星方向: 更细的热图
Board question: Meteor! (c) Finer heat map.

Slide 27

Heat map of the number of reported sightings

Draw a new pdf, f(θ∣x2​), for the meteor’s direction.

Draw a 0.5-probability interval. How long is it?

更细的热图仍显示明显的人口聚集效应. 若沿用同一报告模型, 后验可能进一步集中, 50% 区间继续缩短.

但图像分辨率提高不等于方向测量变准确. 只有把人口密度与报告概率纳入模型, 才能把「有人报告」正确转换成关于轨迹的证据.

讨论: 流星的实际方向
Discussion: Meteor! Actual direction.

Slide 28

(Approximate direction computed by amsmeteors.org referenced earlier.)

Discussion: how good is the data of the heat map for determining the direction of the meteor?

实际轨迹斜穿多个州, 热图最亮处则主要是沿线城市. 单纯按热度猜方向, 很容易把「人多的地方」误当成「流星经过的地方」.

更好的模型应结合目击者位置、观测角、时间和报告机制来估计轨迹. 热图不是没用, 但它记录的是报告过程, 不是流星方向的直接测量.

阅读题参考答案
Reading question answers

Slides 22–23

Here is what we found for answers to the questions:

  1. Airline deaths in 100 years: We found a Wikipedia article that claimed there were 83,772 fatalities due to aviation accidents between 1970 and 2020. In the 50 years before that there were fewer people flying, but it was probably more dangerous. Let’s assume they balance out and estimate the total number of fatalities in 100 years as 2×83,772≈167,000

航空死亡估计先找到 1970–2020 年共 83,772 人的数字. 更早 50 年坐飞机的人较少, 但飞行可能更危险, 于是粗略假设这两种影响相互抵消, 把后 50 年的总数翻倍, 得到 100 年约 167,000 人.

这里最关键的不是乘法, 而是「相互抵消」只是方便估计的假设. 若做概率区间, 应给这个假设留下明显的不确定性, 不能把 167,000 当成精确统计.

Slides 22–23
  1. Number of girls born in the world each year: I had trouble finding a totally reliable source, but most sites gave the same number of, currently, about 140 million births each year. If we take what seems to be the accepted ratio of 1.07 boys born for every girl then 140/2.07=67.6 million baby girls.

女婴估计从每年约 1.4 亿总出生数出发. 男女性别比取 1.07:1, 意味着每 2.07 个新生儿中平均有 1 个女婴, 所以女婴数约为 140/2.07=67.6 百万.

分母用 2.07 而不是 1.07, 因为总人数包括男婴和女婴. 总出生数与性别比本身也有误差, 结果应理解为近似值.

Slides 22–23
  1. It’s hard to get precise numbers but all the sites I found gave similar numbers: For instance, https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=French_language&oldid=1080625160 says there about 76 million native speakers, 235 million daily fluent speakers and and additional 77-110 million secondary speakers who speak it with varying degrees of proficiency.

法语使用者按不同口径分层: 约 7600 万母语者, 2.35 亿日常流利使用者, 另有 7700 万到 1.1 亿熟练程度不一的第二语言使用者.

这些类别可能采用不同定义, 第二语言人数还给的是一个范围. 汇总前必须弄清类别是否互斥、什么叫「流利」, 否则一个看似精确的总数会掩盖口径差异.

Slides 22–23
  1. According to Wikipedia, which is quoting Guttmacher Institute figures, there were 862,300 abortions in the US in 2017. They also quote the CDC figure of 619,591. The difference probably reflects the fact that the CDC is using oﬀicial figures reported by the states and not all states report each year. Also, they are only reporting legal, induced abortions, while Guttmacher is using a more comprehensive survey.

同一年美国流产数, Guttmacher Institute 的估计为 862,300, CDC 数字为 619,591. 差异很可能来自收集方式: CDC 依赖各州官方报告, 而并非所有州每年都报告; Guttmacher 使用更全面的调查.

两个数字的统计范围也不完全相同. 这个例子说明, 数据冲突不一定是谁算错了, 也可能是定义和覆盖率不同. 构造主观区间时应同时考虑这些来源, 而不是任选较符合预期的一个.
